When skill is activated, gains <@ba.vup>{cost}</> DP immediately, Attack Range <@ba.vup>+1</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, ASPD gradually reduces from <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</> to +0; attacks all blocked enemies and each attack can <$ba.stun>Stun</> the enemy for <@ba.vup>{attack@stun}</>s

levels.name: Countergambit
levels.description:
Deals <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage to 6 enemies in front, inflicts <$ba.cold>Cold</> on them and removes their <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</> for <@ba.vup>{cold}</> seconds; the Operator nearest to 'Eye of the Blizzard' has <@ba.vup>-{cost}</> DP Cost (Prioritizes <@ba.vup>Guard/Caster/Sniper</> Operator on the right); All Operators to the left of 'Eye of the Blizzard' cast this skill <@ba.vup>with their own ATK</> once when deployed (stacks 2 times) 
<@ba.rem>Can store 2 charges</>

levels.name: Castled King
levels.description:
Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>, removes enemies' <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</>, attacks deal <@ba.vup>{bird_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage and inflict <@ba.vup>{damage_scale_display:0%}</> <$ba.fragile>Fragile</> to targets in a straight line; immediately gains <@ba.vup>{svash2_s_3[start_cost].cost}</> DP, then gradually gains <@ba.vup>24</> DP
<@ba.rem>On first skill activation, swaps the DP Cost of the Operator with the highest Cost (Prioritizes Guard/Caster/Sniper Operators) with the lowest in the Deployment Waiting Zone</>
<@ba.rem>'Eye of the Blizzard' is deployable when skill is active</>

After <$ba.chant>Chanting</> for <@ba.vdown>{chant_duration}</>s, consumes <@ba.vdown>{sp_cost}</> <$ba.magicpoint>Mana</> to create a familiar to attack; ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, attacks <$ba.sluggish>Slow</> all targets for <@ba.vup>{attack@sluggish}</>s.
Skill can be activated again to upgrade the familiar; attack range <@ba.vup>+1</>, ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>, attacks <$ba.stun>Stun</> the main target for <@ba.vup>{attack@stun}</>s
<@ba.rem>Unlimited duration. Skill can be manually deactivated during first activation</>

levels.name: Explosion Magic
levels.description:
After <$ba.chant>Chanting</> for <@ba.vdown>{chant_duration}</>s, consumes <@ba.vdown>{skill_cost_min_sp}</> <$ba.magicpoint>Mana</> to create an explosion in front of the unit at max range; explosion deals <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage to surrounding enemies and causes high ground tiles to collapse, <$ba.stun>Stunning</> them for <@ba.vup>{stun}</>s
<$ba.chant>Chanting</> can be extended for <@ba.vdown>{extra_chant_duration}</>s; upon completion, consumes <@ba.vdown>all remaining</> <$ba.magicpoint>Mana</>; for every <@ba.vdown>{sp_cost_extra}</> additional <$ba.magicpoint>Mana</> consumed, create 1 additional explosion
<@ba.rem>Extended chanting can be manually deactivated</>

High Ground Form: Upgrades when SP is full (up to 3 times). After the first upgrade, can block 1 enemy and an Operator can be deployed on it. After upgrading 3 times, the device remains on the field even when Nasti retreats

ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>, and Talent 1's splash area <@ba.vup>expands</>; while skill is active, can deploy a Blood's Whisper, which <$ba.attract>Lures</> up to <@ba.vup>{max_target}</> enemies who enter its range and can path to it (prioritizing elite or leader enemies) for <@ba.vup>10</>s after deployment; once the first target arrives at its position, retreats and <$ba.sluggish>Slows</> all surrounding enemies for <@ba.vup>{buff_time}</>s, dealing <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of Tragodia's ATK as Arts damage and <@ba.vup>{ep_damage_ratio_token:0%}</> of Tragodia's ATK as <$ba.dt.neural2>Nervous Impairment</> every <@ba.vup>{interval_damage}</>s
<@ba.rem>Unlimited duration; Blood's Whisper has an independent Redeployment Time</>

levels.name: Saturation Burst
levels.description:
Attack Range <@ba.vup>+1</>, Attack Interval <@ba.vdown>increases</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, DEF <@ba.vup>+{jesca2_s_3[def].def:0%}</>, Mobile Riot Shield gains <@ba.vup>+{jesca2_s_3_token[def].def:0%}</> DEF
When the Mobile Riot Shield is deployed, immediately fires a shell forward that explodes upon reaching a target or its max distance, dealing <@ba.vup>{attack@extrabomb.atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage to all enemies in an area and <$ba.stun>stunning</> them for <@ba.vup>{attack@extrabomb.stun}</> seconds
<@ba.rem>Skill activation grants {attack@trigger_time} Ammo, and the skill ends when all Ammo is used (can be manually deactivated)</>

levels.name: Paths Must Be Opened
levels.description:
Max HP <@ba.vup>+{max_hp:0%}</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>. Immediately throws an anchor forward, stopping when hitting a target or reaching the max distance, dealing <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for <@ba.vup>{stun}</> seconds. If the anchor stops on a tile he can deploy on, Ulpianus will <$ba.addash>Move</> to that tile
<@ba.rem>Skill can be manually deactivated; when skill ends, Ulpianus returns to his original position</>

levels.name: Blessings Unto Yan
levels.description:
Immediately performs <@ba.vup>{times}</> frontal slashes, with each slash dealing <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage to up to <@ba.vup>3</> enemies (the last strike has a doubled damage multiplier, and <$ba.stun>Stuns</> targets for <@ba.vup>{stun}</>s); During this time, the HP recovery effect of this unit's Trait is changed to granting a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to <@ba.vup>{shield_scale}</> times the recovery amount
<@ba.rem>The <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> can stack up to {max_scale}x Max HP, and lasts for {shield_duration}s</>
